# src/audit

The independent check on the Report Card: a second, differently written calculation of every Report Card number, compared with what `stockReport()` serves. It runs as its own process after the nightly averages and turns any disagreement into a log warning.

## Files
| File | What it's for |
|---|---|
| `report-card.ts` | `bun run audit:report-card [date]`: recalculates every number from raw `daily_prices` (follows renames, applies splits, bonuses and demergers itself) for each (registered index, member) card on one session (latest by default), compares with `stockReport()`, prints `✗` lines and a summary, exits 1 on any mismatch. The only things it takes from the app are `stockReport` (the subject), the `db`, and `INDICES` names |
| `cards.ts` | `auditCards(rows, indices)`: which cards to check, one per (registry index, member that day) with that index's members as peers; `isDefault` marks the card a stock's page serves without `u`, fetched the way the page fetches it. Pure, names only |
| `nightly.ts` | `auditSummary` (the summary line, which must end in "N mismatches") and `auditWarnings(exitCode, stdout)`: no warnings for a clean run; otherwise a summary, up to 10 mismatch lines, then a count. No summary line or an exit code other than 0/1 means "audit did not finish" |

## Rules here
- Keep it independent: never import `src/indicators/` or read `daily_indicators`. Two implementations that share code share bugs (decision 0013).
- A new Report Card number goes in `report-card.ts` in the same change as the query (root CLAUDE.md). It checks data and arithmetic; definitions follow decision 0011.
- The market line (NIFTY 50 close and breadth for crashes) is the same for every card; only the Strength peers change by index (decision 0035).
- The summary line's wording is parsed by `nightly.ts`; change `auditSummary` and its `SUMMARY` pattern together (`tests/audit-step.test.ts`).
- One session per run; history rests on unit tests.

## See also
- `src/ingest/cli-nightly.ts` runs it in its own process, after `computeIndicators`, and prints `auditWarnings`.
- `src/query/stock-report.ts` and `src/indicators/risk.ts`: what is being checked.
- Tests: `tests/audit-step.test.ts`.
- Decisions 0013 (independent audit, rounding), 0035 (every index's cards).
